study: Phase 3 outcome-blind pre-event matching caliper sensitivity V5
matching: 1:1 greedy nearest-edge without replacement; exact asset/direction; max 30-day gap
outcome_note: no outcome columns are loaded or used
month_matching: not enforced; month labels are retained only for audit
selection_rule: compare retained pair counts and absolute standardized mean differences; do not select by outcome
limitations: greedy matching is not globally optimal
standardized differences are diagnostics, not proof of exchangeability
residual and unmeasured confounding may remain
broad and strict cohorts are nested
